instruction: Implement only the requirement in the frozen browser page. Replace the single /* MODEL_BEHAVIOR */ marker with vanilla JavaScript statements using the provided app API. Register app.onSave to handle the visible Save button. Do not change any other byte of the page. Return only the complete HTML page.

arms.B: Persist edits to Work and Remaining work when valid. Reject a save if Remaining work exceeds Work.
